decision: Retain A/B Source Sans Pro. First-pass C adds no improvement: Noto Sans SC has distracting full-width-like curly apostrophe spacing in French despite passing exact coverage; Wyvern appears too condensed for the requested open treatment.
revision_reason: No further revision: retain established Source sizes after rejecting unsuitable rendered alternatives.
counterargument: Noto Sans SC has robust clear digits and could potentially be fixed with other OpenType width features; that was not investigated within this comparison. Source benefits from prior size tuning.
score_observations: Bilingual notice and time columns remain easy to scan.
Dates and times clearly stand apart.
Single-family coherence with natural French punctuation spacing.

Lander Tall seen/rendered in earlier C case-c; not rendered here.
